This worked.. but remove cl and vl images of course: ``` participants_matrix: el: - el_type: geth el_image: ethpandaops/geth:bal-devnet-6 el_extra_params: ["--rpc.txfeecap=0", "--rpc.gascap=0"] cl: - cl_type: prysm cl_image: gcr.io/offchainlabs/prysm/beacon-chain:latest vc_type: prysm vc_image: gcr.io/offchainlabs/prysm/validator:latest count: 1 network_params: gloas_fork_epoch: 1 preset: minimal withdrawal_type: "0x01" validator_balance: 40000 additional_services: - dora - assertoor - spamoor - checkpointz assertoor_params: image: ethpandaops/assertoor:master run_stability_check: false run_block_proposal_check: false tests: - file: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jtraglia/kurtosis-devnets/refs/heads/master/assertoor-playbooks/builder-deposits.yml" config: totalDeposits: 262144 perSlot: 8192 startSlot: 0 # asap dora_params: image: ethpandaops/dora:master ``` im only able to get 1k deposits so its 100ms... will like to see more Will test on my plebeian laptop soon 😄 can i make these larger so we get more deposits? what number would you recommend for 8k? ``` totalDeposits: 262144 perSlot: 8192 ``` That’s not the bottleneck. Assertoor (or just the EL) needs to send them faster. If you increase seconds_per_slot to 12, there should be more per slot too. you also need to increase your gaslimit of course we still default to 60m we should probably change the default gas to 200m on kt so we wouldn’t need to set this hm ya i was about to say with 12s i only get `1034` deposits per block yeah check dora’s execution blocks you will see how much gas is getting used per block https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/pull/1391 once this is merged we won’t need to override it but for now set these in your network params with 200m genesis gas, i can only make it go up to 3600 deposits per block, still too easy. im gonna try 400m and see what happens with 400m gas, i got up to 5k deposits Ah in my config I had set genesis gas limit to 200m and also saw ~3k or so. Before I test with Prysm, I want to mention that Teku suffers from the same issue but it's much more gradual. I am seeing `Recv` times of ~7 seconds after 600 slots. are you hitting gas limit bottlenecks tho? check the el page 0% sync aggregation tho tried giga gas, 12s, and double justin's number in kurtosis config, still cant get above 5k deposits per block. ``` network_params: gloas_fork_epoch: 1 preset: minimal withdrawal_type: "0x01" validator_balance: 40000 seconds_per_slot: 12 gas_limit: 1000000000 genesis_gaslimit: 1000000000 additional_services: - dora - assertoor - spamoor - checkpointz assertoor_params: image: ethpandaops/assertoor:master run_stability_check: false run_block_proposal_check: false tests: - file: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jtraglia/kurtosis-devnets/refs/heads/master/assertoor-playbooks/builder-deposits.yml" config: totalDeposits: 262144 perSlot: 20000 startSlot: 0 # asap ``` I have a feeling we are bottlenecked by assertoor here cc <@808969530608451584> <@363800010518822915> nice, it was working pretty well for a while. Just borked though. not sure what happened.. got some logs to share? Can share in a bit. Cooking dinner right now lol. yea, sending so many deposits via individual transactions doesn't really work reliably. some clients reject transactions when the nonce gap gets too big during parallel submission. this uses a batching contract in between: ``` # kurtosis config snippet assertoor_params: image: ethpandaops/assertoor:master run_stability_check: false run_block_proposal_check: false tests: - file: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ethpandaops/assertoor/refs/heads/master/playbooks/gloas-dev/builder-deposit-spam.yaml" config: batchSize: 200 pendingBatches: 30 # 20*200 = 6000 deposits per block totalDeposits: 1000000 skipForkActivationCheck: true # deposit before gloas activation ``` Does it work with 200m genesis gas limit? yea, shouldn't break anything use with caution 😄 my computer just completely froze with a OOM cascade, running 6 geth pairs that each tried to get like 20G memory when sending 6k deposits per block 😄
